info.title: Web Compiler
info.description: Excubo.WebCompiler is a dotnet global tool that compiles Scss files (other languages on the road map).

options.name: --config
options.description: Specify a configuration file for compilation.

options.name: --defaults
options.description: Write a default configuration file (file name is webcompilerconfiguration.json, if none is specified).

options.name: --files
options.description: Specify a list of files that should be compiled.

options.name: --minify
options.description: Enable/disable minification (default: enabled), ignored if configuration file is provided.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Specify the output directory, ignored if configuration file is provided.

options.name: --preserve
options.description: Enable/disable whether to preserve intermediate files (default: enabled).

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recursively search folders for compilable files (only if any of the provided arguments is a folder).

options.name: --zip
options.description: Enable/disable gzip (default: enabled), ignored if configuration file is provided.
